messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — doing a lightning micro-launch this weekend to drive webinar signups and collect bench narrative pull quotes. Need fast checks: X and LinkedIn posts, creative assets, and SDR routing for inbound leads. Target window: Sat 9–11am PT. @Samir can you do the scheduling?
Samir Patel: Yep I can schedule. Need the final copy + CTAs for both X and LinkedIn. Will do a staggered cadence: X at 09:15, LinkedIn at 09:30, follow-up thread at 10:00. Any preferences on UTM params?
Jordan Lee: Creative pack uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEFgHIjk
Contains: hero image (1200x628), 2 short clips (15s), and 1 slide deck excerpt. I tweaked visuals for mobile. :sparkles: 
Alex Morgan: Use `utm_source=twitter_x` / `utm_medium=social` for X and `utm_source=linkedin` for LI. Final CTA: "Register for live demo" with /register link. Example UTMs: `?utm_source=twitter_x&utm_campaign=microlaunch_apr&utm_medium=social`
Priya Desai: Budget note — we'd like to run a small retargeting seed to people who click the hero for 24h post-launch. I'll queue a $250 spend to start. Can the creative include 1:1 copy variations for retargeting?
Jordan Lee: Yep added 2 caption variants in the Drive. One is more product-focused, one is benchmark-first. Filename suffix `_vA` and `_vB`.
Lucas Rivera: SDR routing — please tag all inbound leads from this campaign with `campaign:microlaunch_apr` in the webhook payload. We'll have an ops rule to escalate anyone with company size >50 to priority queue. @Maya can you confirm the field name in the form?
Maya Chen: Form field is `lead_source_campaign`. Add `microlaunch_apr` there and set `lead_priority=high` if they check "Book a demo". Also add `origin_channel` = `x` or `linkedin` depending on which link they clicked.
Samir Patel: Putting draft posts below — please approve quickly.

X (thread):
Jordan Lee (copy A): "We just unlocked faster, cheaper LLM inference for production. Join our live demo to see how teams cut latency and cost. Register: rwd.io/demo #inference #mlops"
Jordan Lee (copy B): "Benchmark: 3x token speed + 2x cost savings in common gen workloads. See it live — sign up: rwd.io/demo"

LinkedIn (single):
Jordan Lee: "Redwood Inference — making production LLMs predictable. Join our webinar to watch real benchmark comparisons, live Q&A, and deployment playbooks. Register: rwd.io/demo"

Samir Patel: Approved from my side with UTMs. I'll schedule using the Drive assets and include thread reply at 10:00 linking to the clip.
Maya Chen: Awesome. SDR routing checklist: Lucas, make sure your webhooks map `origin_channel` and append `utm_campaign` to lead notes. Also email notify `sales@redwood.ai` for high-priority leads.
Lucas Rivera: On it. I'll patch the webhook by 08:00 PT tomorrow and run a dry test. If anyone wants to test, DM me and I can trigger a fake lead.
ops-bot: Posting reminder — social-scheduler job created: `job_463777-ml` scheduled for 2026-05-02T16:15:00Z
Priya Desai: Thanks — I'll start the retargeting audience build now.
Alex Morgan: One more ask: can we add a one-line reviewer quote slot for bench narratives? Something like "Saw 40% latency drop in A/B" — short and punchy.
Maya Chen: Good call. Jordan, can you mock a few quote overlays that we can A/B test on the clips?
Jordan Lee: Yep, adding 3 overlay options: numeric, customer-voice, and product-benefit. Uploading in 20.
Samir Patel: Scheduler will post X, LI, and then a reminder DM to creators with performance link at +24h.
Maya Chen: Perfect. If no other blockers, let's lock and ship. Thanks team — move fast, low ceremony. :rocket:
Samir Patel: Locked. I'll post the URLs after scheduling.
Jordan Lee: Uploaded overlays and final captions. :white_check_mark: 
Lucas Rivera: Webhook test passed. Leads show `campaign:microlaunch_apr` and `origin_channel` set. Will monitor.
Priya Desai: Retargeting seed audience ready.
Maya Chen: Congrats — we're live this weekend. I'll post a final thread summary after the first hour with early metrics. Good luck everyone!
